$schema-note: Reproducibility manifest for one unit's art. Pre-filled from art/style/ (house-style.md + prompts-units.md). Fill in sha256, seed(s), controlnet model, and handEditing after generating. See docs/art-generation.md.
role: Healer / support — 400 hp, no attack, 100 mana, heals allies (heal range 4, mint-green FX). Trained at the Monastery. Fragile and precious; not part of the combat RPS triangle.

generation.styleFragment: soft hand-painted 2D game sprite, high-angle 3/4 top-down view, chibi proportions with large rounded head and small stout body and short stubby limbs, soft volumetric cel shading, single soft light from top-left, gentle gradient form shadows, soft ambient occlusion, crisp rim highlight, thin dark desaturated outline, cohesive muted palette of teal slate-blue warm-sand and soft-green, bold readable silhouette, cute by proportion not by expression, single character centered, transparent background, no cast ground shadow, consistent line weight, game asset, clean edges
generation.unitPrompt: a gentle chibi monk in a long hooded robe, a deep soft cowl, a wooden staff topped with a small glowing orb, a blue sash or robe trim as the team color, hands raised in a soft mint-green healing glow, no weapon, peaceful serene simple face partly shadowed by the hood, soft and fragile, a supportive mystic
generation.teamColorZone: blue sash / robe trim (generate master in blue key, recolor per team)
generation.negativePrompt: side view, front orthographic view, flat orthographic, isometric grid, realistic human proportions, tall lanky body, heavy black comic ink outline, cel-shaded anime, harsh cast shadow on ground, busy background, scenery, multiple characters, text, watermark, signature, logo, oversaturated neon colors, gradient background, photorealistic, 3d render, blurry, low contrast, extra limbs, deformed hands, exaggerated screaming face, bulging eyes, weapon, armor, sword

controlnet.poses: art/units/monk/poses/  (OpenPose skeletons, one per frame, posed from a high 3/4 angle)

heal.note: signature action: raise hands, emit soft mint-green heal aura toward an ally (this unit has no attack — heal replaces attack)

handEditing: FILL_IN — describe any manual cleanup/compositing done.
deployedTo: UnityRTS/RTS/Assets/... (path where the finished sheet is imported into Unity)
notes: The only unit with magic FX (mint-green additive glow, used sparingly). Robe silhouette must stay distinct from the fighters — flowing hem, no armor, no weapon. No combat animation; the heal is its signature action.
